info.title: Bonfire API
info.description:
The HTTP API of Bonfire, a Jellyfin plugin. `version` is `apiVersion` from `GET /info`: it goes up only when a released route changes in a way that breaks callers. Plugin ID `b1462fca-774b-4b13-8d02-e2d4f2bc18b9`. Jellyfin 10.11.x and 12.0.

Bodies are JSON unless stated otherwise. Jellyfin picks the casing of fields it returns: PascalCase by default, camelCase if the request sends `Accept: application/json; profile="CamelCase"`. Requests are read either way. Examples show camelCase.

Error bodies are plain text for the user; read the `X-Bonfire-Error` header to decide what to do. Fields not listed here may appear in any release: ignore what you do not recognize.

The guide parts (authentication, errors, rate limits, switching) are in the Developer API page.

get.summary: Version and which features are on
get.description: Call this first, with no token. A 404 means Bonfire is not installed. `disabled: true` means an administrator has switched it off: show no Bonfire screens. Sent with `no-store`.

200.description: Version and which features are on.

get.description: Everything the profile picker needs, in one request. `info`, `profiles` and `themes` are what `GET /info`, `GET /list` and `GET /themes` return for the same caller. If any part would be refused, the whole call is refused the same way, never a partial body. An API key has no user and gets 401. Sent with `no-store`.

get.summary: Profiles the caller can switch to
get.description: Every profile the caller can switch to: their own household, then any linked Bonfire. Sent with an `ETag`; send it back as `If-None-Match` for a 304. The rating limit is not in this list: read `Policy.MaxParentalRating` from Jellyfin's `GET /Users/{id}`.

post.summary: Switch to a profile and get its token
post.description: Returns a new token and, unless `endPreviousSession` is sent, leaves the old session signed in. The target must be in the caller's household or Bonfire. Another household's account needs its PIN, even on the home network, unless its owner turned on `allowHouseholdLanBypass`.

endPreviousSession.description: Sign out the token that made this request once the new one exists. Default false. If the switch fails, nothing is signed out.

activeProfileToken.description: A Jellyfin token for the profile.

libraryArtwork.description: The profile's library artwork, as `GET /library-artwork` returns it.

post.description: Answers "may I open this profile", so it returns 200 without checking the PIN wherever opening needs none. To check the main account's PIN, use `/account/verify-pin`.
Checks the main account's PIN, always: the home network and `askPinToOpen` do not skip it. A main account, not one of its profiles.

200.description: The PIN is correct, or the account has no PIN.

post.summary: Set the main account's PIN and whether opening it asks
post.description: The main account's own settings. A main account, not one of its profiles. A field left out keeps its value. An account with no PIN can set one without `masterPin`, even while the server requires it.

masterPin.description: The current PIN. Needed when the account has one.

pin.description: A new PIN, 4 to 8 digits. `""` clears it, refused while the server requires main PINs.

askPinToOpen.description: Ask for the PIN to open the account.

bypassPinOnLocalNetwork.description: Skip the PIN on the home network.

lockoutMinutes.description: Minutes before the account locks. 0 is never. Clamped to 0 to 1440.

timeZone.description: The household's IANA time zone, such as `Europe/Paris`. `""` follows the server default.

post.description: A main account, not one of its profiles. `main_pin_required` while the server requires main PINs and the account has none.

Takes the same fields as `/create`, plus `profileId`. `profileName` is required. Every other field left out or `null` stays as it is. `""` clears `pin`, `profileImage`, `maxParentalRating` and `theme`; `[]` clears the tag lists. `allLibraries: true` gives every library, `enabledFolders` gives that list, neither keeps them, both is 400. Only the main account may set a `theme`, with its PIN: 400 for an id the server does not offer, 403 while the server does not let profiles choose.

schema.description: Sent when a `theme` was part of the request. Otherwise the answer is 200 with no fields documented.

post.summary: Copy one profile's rules onto another
post.description: Copies the rating limit, tags, libraries and viewing limits of one profile onto another in the same household. Devices, name, image and PIN are not changed. A main account only. Both profiles must be the caller's; a profile of another household, the main account, a standalone user and one that does not exist all get `403 not_your_profile`. Two identical ids are 400. Viewing limits need a main PIN.

post.summary: A profile changes its own name and image
post.description: A profile changes its own name and image without the main PIN. Only a profile: a main account gets 403. There is no `profileId`. Nothing else can be sent; a field that names rating, PIN, libraries, tags, limits, devices or theme is ignored. Every field left out or `null` stays as it is.

post.summary: Delete a profile and its account
post.description: Deletes a profile and its Jellyfin account. A profile made from an existing account is not deleted: the account stays and signs in on its own with `password`, or a random one if that is empty. 500 if the account could not be deleted; it is disabled instead and the profile stays listed.

get.summary: What the profile form reads: libraries, rating limits, avatars, time zones
get.description: Everything the profile form reads that is the same for every profile. An administrator's API key is answered with `timeZones` only; the other three parts are null.

The client script, as `application/javascript`. `ETag` is the plugin version, with `-off` while Bonfire is turned off. `Cache-Control` is `public, no-cache`. While Bonfire is turned off it is the same script, told to draw nothing.
One language's strings, as a flat object. `ETag` is `"{pluginVersion}-{locale}"`, with `-admin` added for `part=admin`. There is no route listing the languages.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: A language code. May end in `.json`.

parameters.name: part
parameters.description: `admin` returns only the admin settings page's strings (keys starting `admin.`). Without it, every other key.

503.description: The file could not be read. Stay on English and try later.

get.description: A profile's stored image. If there is no small version, the full one is sent, so `size=thumb` is always safe. 404 if there is no stored image, including when the image is an `http(s)` link: load that from `profileImage` in `/list`.

get.summary: The caller's library artwork, or one of their profiles' with `profileId`
get.description: The caller's choices. With `profileId`, the same list for one of the caller's profiles: 403 if it is not theirs, or if the caller is a profile. `mode` is `custom` (use `url`) or `none` (no image). Libraries left on the default are not listed.

post.description: `custom` with no image keeps the stored one, or is refused if there is not one.

get.description: The stored image for a `custom` choice.

The devices the caller's household has used. A profile calling this gets its main account's devices, but only if the main account is open or the request carries its PIN in `X-Bonfire-Master-Pin`. Otherwise the list is empty. Every device already on an allowed list is included. When you save a profile, keep allowed devices you were not shown: an empty `allowedDeviceIds` means any device.

nameCode.description: Left out for an ordinary device.

clientCode.description: Left out for an ordinary device.

post.description: Forgets the device for your household and takes it off your profiles' device lists. 400 if your household has never used it, or if it is the only device one of your profiles is allowed on (`device_in_use`).

post.summary: Merge two records for one device
post.description: For one machine with two records. Must be the main account and own both devices. Profiles allowed on `fromDeviceId` become allowed on `intoDeviceId`, the old record is removed, and a request from it counts as `intoDeviceId`. 400 if either is unknown, they are the same, or one is not the caller's.

post.summary: Find, and optionally merge, duplicate records
post.description: Finds records that look like one machine: same client, same name, and device ids from the same browser version. Must be the main account. The main PIN header is needed with `apply=true`.

parameters.name: apply
parameters.description: Merge each group into its most recent record. Without it, only reports.

post.description: The name is kept even when the device reports a different one. Trimmed to 64 characters. 400 for an unknown device or a blank name.

hideMySubProfilesFromOthers.description: Others in the Bonfire cannot see or open the caller's profiles.

hideOthersSubProfilesFromMe.description: The caller does not see others' profiles.

allowHouseholdLanBypass.description: Others may open this account on the home network without its PIN.

isAdministrator.description: The caller is a Jellyfin administrator, for warning before turning the bypass on.

hasPin.description: The caller's main account has a PIN.

post.description: A field left out keeps its value. Before turning the bypass on, warn that an administrator account gives anyone who opens it control of the server, and that "home network" is whatever Jellyfin counts as local: behind a reverse proxy missing from Known Proxies, that is everyone.

post.summary: Start a Bonfire, or change the code of the one you have
post.description: Starts a Bonfire. If the caller already has one, this changes its code instead and removes no one; the old code stops working.

post.summary: Join a Bonfire with a code
post.description: Joining leaves any Bonfire the caller was already in. 400 bad code or your own Bonfire, 403 not a main account.

post.summary: Remove a member and change the code
post.description: Removes the member and changes the code so they cannot rejoin.
Leaves the Bonfire the caller joined.
Ends the caller's Bonfire and removes everyone from it.

get.summary: Other accounts on the caller's switcher, and the switchers it's on
get.description: For main accounts.

shownIn.description: The switchers the caller is on.

post.summary: Add another account, with its password
post.description: Returns the `GET` shape. A wrong password counts against the same limits as a wrong PIN, but not against Jellyfin's lockout for that account. An account that signs in through LDAP, SSO or similar can only be added by an administrator.

shownIn.description: The switchers the caller is on.

post.summary: Take an account off, or leave another switcher
post.description: Send `userId` to take an account off the caller's switcher, or `householdId` to take the caller off someone else's. Returns the `GET` shape. `link_not_found` otherwise.

shownIn.description: The switchers the caller is on.

get.description: Each household chooses these for itself. A profile reads its main account's.

askOnStartup.description: Show "Who's watching?" once per browser session.

switcherLocation.description: `button`: a Bonfire button in the header. `menu`: a Switch Profile entry in Jellyfin's user menu.

masterUserId.description: The account these belong to, for caching.

emergencyCodeConfigured.description: An administrator has set an emergency code.

theme.description: The theme to show this account.

post.description: Both fields are optional. Returns the stored values in the `GET` shape; cache those rather than what you sent. 403 for a profile.

askOnStartup.description: Show "Who's watching?" once per browser session.

switcherLocation.description: `button`: a Bonfire button in the header. `menu`: a Switch Profile entry in Jellyfin's user menu.

masterUserId.description: The account these belong to, for caching.

emergencyCodeConfigured.description: An administrator has set an emergency code.

theme.description: The theme to show this account.

post.description: No body. Records that this account has seen the current setup, finished or skipped. A profile gets 200 and nothing is recorded.

post.summary: Show first-time setup to every main account again
post.description: Every main account sees first-time setup again on its next visit.

get.description: Every theme as a file, for an app that draws its own switcher. Hidden built-ins are left out of `themes` and named in `hidden`. Sent with an `ETag`.

parameters.name: part
parameters.description: `custom` returns only the custom themes and uploaded fonts.

get.description: One built-in pattern image, as SVG. 404 for a name Bonfire does not hold, which includes an uploaded image's name.

get.summary: A custom theme's uploaded pattern image
get.description: A pattern image an administrator uploaded. Served with an `ETag` and cached for good.

post.summary: Upload a pattern image for a custom theme
post.description: The body is the image: PNG or WebP, up to 2 MB, 16 to 1024 pixels on each side. Not SVG, JPEG, GIF, an animated WebP or an APNG. Only stores it; a custom theme names it in a `pattern` decoration's `image` when saved.

get.summary: One font file, or its license
get.description: One font file, or the license that comes with it. Sent with `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *` and an `ETag`.

get.summary: Custom themes, hidden themes and uploaded fonts
get.description: Every custom theme is listed, with its problems. One with problems is not offered anywhere until it is fixed.

theme.description: A theme file, schema 1. See docs/themes.md.

post.summary: Check a theme without saving it
post.description: The body is a theme file. Saves nothing.

schema.description: A theme file, schema 1. See docs/themes.md.

put.description: The body is a theme file whose `id` is `{id}`. Adds it, or replaces the custom theme with that id. Send a `revision` above the stored one: an edit made from an older copy gets `409 theme_changed` and leaves the newer save as it is. A file with no `revision` is still accepted and takes the next one. 400 with `{ message, problems }` when it does not pass, and 400 when 40 are already stored.

schema.description: A theme file, schema 1. See docs/themes.md.

409.description: Saved again after the copy you edited (`theme_changed`).

delete.description: Deletes a custom theme. 400 if it is the default.

put.summary: Choose which built-in themes to hide
put.description: Replaces the list. Built-in ids only, never `bonfire` or the default. Returns the list as stored.

post.description: The body is the font file itself: WOFF2, at most 2 MB, able to draw A to Z, a to z and 0 to 9. The file is stored under a name made from its contents; uploading the same file again returns the font already there. Up to 20 fonts. Returns the font as `GET /admin/themes` lists it.

parameters.name: rights
parameters.description: `true`: the administrator has the right to use the font.

parameters.name: family
parameters.description: The name to use. Letters, digits, spaces, `-`, `_` and `.`, up to 64. Defaults to the name in the file.

delete.description: Deletes an uploaded font and its file. 400 while a custom theme uses it (`font_in_use`).

put.summary: Set the logo's text, alt text and corners
put.description: A field left out stays as it is. Send `""` or `null` to clear `text` or `alt`. `text` is one line up to 40 characters, `alt` up to 100. Returns the logo as `GET /themes` gives it.

post.description: The body is the image: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 1 MB, 16 to 4096 pixels on each side. Not SVG or GIF. Replaces the current image.

delete.description: Removes the image. The text shows instead, if there is one.

get.description: The logo image. The address changes whenever the image does, so it can be cached for good. 404 for anything but the current logo.

post.summary: Upload a background image for a custom theme
post.description: The body is the image: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 2 MB, 320 to 4096 pixels on each side. Not SVG, GIF or an animated WebP. Only stores it: a custom theme names it in `background.image.file` when saved.

get.description: A background image, by the name `background.image.file` gives. Named by its contents, so it can be cached for good.

get.summary: The main account's email address and notices
get.description: The main account only, with its PIN in `X-Bonfire-Master-Pin` if it has one.

pendingAddress.description: An address waiting for its code, or empty.

notifyLockout.description: Mail when a PIN in the household is locked by wrong tries.

notifyNewDevice.description: Mail when the household signs in on a new device.

notifyTimeAsked.description: Mail when a profile asks for more time.

notifyLimitReached.description: Mail when a profile uses up its daily limit.

pinResetEnabled.description: The administrator allows PIN reset by email.

post.summary: Send a code to a new address, remove the address, or choose which notices to get
post.description: The main account's email settings in one call. The main account only, with its PIN. All fields but `masterPin` are optional, and at least one of `address` and the four switches is needed (400 otherwise). Returns the `GET` shape.

address.description: A new address: a code is sent to it, and nothing is stored until it is confirmed. An empty string removes the address and any code waiting for one. Left out, the address is not touched.

language.description: The language the mail is written in, a tag such as `fr`.

pendingAddress.description: An address waiting for its code, or empty.

notifyLockout.description: Mail when a PIN in the household is locked by wrong tries.

notifyNewDevice.description: Mail when the household signs in on a new device.

notifyTimeAsked.description: Mail when a profile asks for more time.

notifyLimitReached.description: Mail when a profile uses up its daily limit.

pinResetEnabled.description: The administrator allows PIN reset by email.

post.summary: Confirm the address with the code
post.description: Stores the address. `language` is kept for notices sent later. The main account only, with its PIN. Returns the `GET` shape.

pendingAddress.description: An address waiting for its code, or empty.

notifyLockout.description: Mail when a PIN in the household is locked by wrong tries.

notifyNewDevice.description: Mail when the household signs in on a new device.

notifyTimeAsked.description: Mail when a profile asks for more time.

notifyLimitReached.description: Mail when a profile uses up its daily limit.

pinResetEnabled.description: The administrator allows PIN reset by email.

post.summary: Email a code to reset a forgotten main PIN
post.description: Sends a code to the confirmed address. The main account only. No PIN: this is for an account that has forgotten it. 400 unless `me.pinResetByEmail` in `/startup` is true.

post.summary: Set a new main PIN with the code
post.description: Sets the main account's PIN and lifts any lock on it. The address gets a note saying the PIN changed. Profiles' PINs are reset by the main account, not by email.

get.summary: Outgoing mail settings and confirmed addresses
get.description: The password is never returned. It is stored in plain text in the plugin configuration. The configuration export leaves it out.

hasPassword.description: The password itself is never returned.

post.description: All fields optional. Returns the `GET` shape. Changing anything the connection uses makes it unverified until the next test, and everything that needs email stops until then.

security.description: `none` is for a relay on your own network.

username.description: Empty for a server that takes none.

password.description: Omit to keep the stored one; empty clears it.

hasPassword.description: The password itself is never returned.

post.summary: Send a test message, which makes email available
post.description: Sends a test message with the saved settings. If it goes through, email becomes available. 400 with a reason if it does not. Returns the `GET` shape.

hasPassword.description: The password itself is never returned.

post.description: The account stops getting codes and notices.

get.summary: A profile's viewing hours and where it stands now
get.description: A signed-in user in the profile's household, or an administrator. To show your own warning, poll once a minute during playback and warn when `minutesLeft` is 5 or less.

limited.description: Hours or a limit are on. When false, the rest is empty.

binding.description: What ends it first: `hours`, `limit` or `extra`. Empty when nothing does today.

days.description: Days as bits: Sunday is 1, Monday 2, through Saturday 64.

end.description: `HH:mm`. An end at or before the start runs past midnight; `24:00` is midnight.

weekendMinutes.description: Saturday and Sunday. Null is the same as other days.

post.summary: Set a profile's viewing hours and daily limit
post.description: The profile's main account with its PIN, or an administrator. The main account needs a PIN to turn limits on. A field left out keeps its value. `[]`, `0` and `false` turn each part off. Up to 28 windows; limits 0 to 1440. Errors: `limits_invalid`, `limits_for_profiles`, `main_pin_required`.

days.description: Days as bits: Sunday is 1, Monday 2, through Saturday 64.

end.description: `HH:mm`. An end at or before the start runs past midnight; `24:00` is midnight.

language.description: The language of the messages its apps get.

limited.description: Hours or a limit are on. When false, the rest is empty.

binding.description: What ends it first: `hours`, `limit` or `extra`. Empty when nothing does today.

days.description: Days as bits: Sunday is 1, Monday 2, through Saturday 64.

end.description: `HH:mm`. An end at or before the start runs past midnight; `24:00` is midnight.

weekendMinutes.description: Saturday and Sunday. Null is the same as other days.

post.summary: Give a profile more time, or say no
post.description: Signed-in user in the profile's household, with the main account's PIN, or an administrator. 1 to 240 minutes. `0` says no to a request and leaves time already given. One profile can be given at most 240 minutes in a household day: a grant past it is 400 `grant_cap` and gives nothing.

limited.description: Hours or a limit are on. When false, the rest is empty.

binding.description: What ends it first: `hours`, `limit` or `extra`. Empty when nothing does today.

get.summary: The household's profiles waiting for more time
get.description: The caller's own household's requests, never another's. An API key has no household and gets 403. The profiles that have asked for more time and are still waiting, oldest first.

grantMinutesLeft.description: 240 less what was given today. At 0 only no is left.

post.description: Signed-in user in the profile's household. No body. The main account's open apps get a message, and an email if it chose that. Once every ten minutes; sooner is 429.

limited.description: Hours or a limit are on. When false, the rest is empty.

binding.description: What ends it first: `hours`, `limit` or `extra`. Empty when nothing does today.

get.description: One avatar. 404 if it is unknown, or it is a starter avatar while those are off.

post.description: `image` must fit the image quality's limit. `displayName` is trimmed to 60 characters and defaults to "Avatar". Returns the new entry. 400 for an unreadable or oversized image.

delete.description: Removes an avatar. Profiles using it keep their copy.

get.summary: List images in a server folder
get.description: Lists images in a folder on the server, for importing a set. At most 200 files; `truncated` says there were more.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The folder as the server sees it.

get.description: One file from that folder. The client resizes it and posts it to `POST /admin/avatars`.
Every stored announcement, newest first, each with `createdUtc` and `showing`. Ones that ended more than 30 days ago are dropped on the next save.

post.description: Leave out `id` to create one; send it to replace that one. `message` is 1 to 280 characters. `severity` is `info` (the default), `warning` or `critical`. `startsUtc: null` shows it now, `endsUtc: null` keeps it until it is deleted. Dates without a zone are read as UTC. At most 50 are stored. Returns the saved announcement.

example.message: The server restarts at 2am for an update.

post.description: An id that is already gone is not an error.

get.description: Whether the server is closed to everyone but administrators.

post.description: While on, every request from an account that is not an administrator gets 503, `X-Bonfire-Error: maintenance`, a `Retry-After` and the message as plain text. `message` is up to 280 characters; blank shows "The server is closed for maintenance." `untilUtc` must be in the future. `reopenAutomatically` (default false) reopens the server at `untilUtc`, and is 400 without one. `stopPlayback: true` stops what household members are playing and refuses video and audio too.

200.description: The saved state, plus `told` and `stopped`: the number of apps messaged and stopped when closing.

post.description: Turns Bonfire's client script off until Jellyfin restarts. It does not open other profiles or loosen Jellyfin's own library, rating or tag restrictions. 400 for a wrong code, and also when no code is set, so the response does not reveal which. 429 after 5 tries in an hour.

get.description: Sent with `no-store`. Only the emergency code sets it; to know whether Bonfire is turned off, read `disabled` from `/info`.
The code itself is never returned.

post.description: An empty code turns the feature off.

Changes only the fields you send. Use this instead of Jellyfin's `POST /Plugins/{id}/Configuration`, which replaces the whole configuration and loses anything added since you read it. 400 if any field is out of range, and then nothing is changed.

pinGuessesPerDay.description: Wrong PIN tries an account may have in a day. 1 to 20, default 20. It can only be lowered.

requireMainPin.description: Main accounts must set a PIN before changing profiles or settings.

disallowCustomAvatarUploads.description: Images only from the avatar library.

bonfireOn.description: Bonfire on or off. Off does what the emergency code does, without a restart either way.

defaultAskOnStartup.description: Default for accounts that have not chosen.

allowProfileThemes.description: Let profiles choose their own theme. Turning it off keeps their choices for later.

richThemeMotion.description: Let themes with a special animation use it. Default off.

profileImageQuality.description: `standard` (512 px, 2 MB), `high` (1024 px, 4 MB), `maximum` (2048 px, 8 MB) or `ultra` (4096 px, 16 MB).

onboardingAsked.description: The dashboard's new-install question about first-time setup has been answered.

gettingStartedDismiss.description: Hide one item of the Status tab's Getting started list for every administrator. There is no undo.

enablePinResetByEmail.description: Main accounts may reset a forgotten PIN by email. 400 turning it on while email is not working.

defaultTimeZone.description: An IANA id, or `""` for the server's own.

address.description: An address or range, such as `203.0.113.0/24`.

userIds.description: Real main accounts, never a profile and never an administrator.

trustedAddressEntries.description: Addresses where a household opens without a PIN. `[]` turns it off. At most 10 entries; no range wider than /16 (IPv4) or /48 (IPv6); IPv4 as dotted decimal only; an address once. It never skips an administrator's PIN, a switch into another household, or the main PIN for changing household settings.

get.description: Every account and profile, and whether the client script is reaching browsers.

post.description: Clears that profile's PIN.

Finds records for Jellyfin users that were deleted outside Bonfire. They still count against the profile limit. `apply=false`, the default, only reports. `apply=true` removes them. There is no undo. Devices are never removed by this. `unusedImages` and `removedImages` count theme images no custom theme names.

get.description: Every live session, with the household it belongs to, most recent first. `masterUsername` is null for an account outside Bonfire.

post.description: Signs out that one account on that one device. Both fields are required, so other profiles on the same TV stay signed in. 400 if either is missing or there is no such session.

get.description: The whole configuration, with the version and time. By default the file includes every PIN, hashed; keep it as safe as a password. The file always leaves out the mail server password and the emergency code.

parameters.name: includePins
parameters.description: `false` leaves out every `PinHash`, and an import of that file keeps the PIN each row already has.

configuration.description: The plugin configuration. Field names are the configuration's own and may change in any release.

post.description: The body is the `configuration` object from an export. Profiles, devices, Bonfires and the avatar library are each replaced whole; a section the file does not include is left alone. The mail password and emergency code are kept as the server has them when the file has none. Field names are matched ignoring case. Profiles for users this server does not have are dropped and named in the response. 400 if the body is not a Bonfire configuration; nothing is changed then.

bonfireOn.description: Whether Bonfire is on after the import.

post.summary: Check the script is reaching browsers again
post.description: Checks again whether the script is reaching browsers, and removes any tags an older version left in `index.html`.
`maxProfiles` is 1 to 20, or null to use the server-wide limit again. 400 if it is out of range.

post.summary: Make a profile its own account
post.description: Makes a profile an ordinary Jellyfin account. It keeps the libraries and limits it has now and inherits nothing afterwards. Its sessions are signed out and it signs in with the new password, on Jellyfin's own provider. It cannot be undone.

username.description: Optional; blank keeps the current one.

post.summary: Make an account a profile of another
post.description: The reverse of `standalone`. The account becomes a profile of `householdId` and keeps its user, so watch history stays, and its PIN, libraries, tags and image. Its password is replaced with a random one, its sessions are signed out, it is hidden from the sign-in screen, and its email and added accounts are removed. `not_convertible` for an administrator, an account with profiles, one in a Bonfire, one that is already a profile, or a `householdId` that is a profile. `profile_limit` and `name_taken` as for `/create`.

deleteWithProfile.description: What deleting the profile later does. `false` (the default) keeps the account; `true` deletes it.

post.summary: Add an account to a switcher
post.description: Adds `userId` to `householdId`'s switcher without its password. Same errors as `POST /accounts/links/add`, less `credentials_wrong`.
Takes it off. `link_not_found` if it is not there.

Sets one household's PIN prompts: `askPinToOpen` on the main account, and `bypassPinOnLocalNetwork` on each profile named. Nothing else changes and no PIN is touched. Both parts are optional. All or nothing: one refused profile changes nothing. 400 for a `householdId` that is a profile or has none, an administrator's own household, or a profile that is not in it. 404 for an unknown user.

get.description: Recent switches: the newest 1,000, and none older than 90 days.

post.description: Deletes the whole switch log, in memory and on disk. No body. There is no undo. 500 if the file could not be written; the log is then unchanged.

MediaBrowser.name: Authorization
MediaBrowser.description: Jellyfin's usual header: `MediaBrowser Client="<Client>", Device="<Device>", DeviceId="<DeviceId>", Version="<Version>", Token="<token>"`. Manage profiles with the main account's token; after a switch, use the token it returns. Administrator routes also take an API key from Dashboard, API Keys, sent as the token. A key has no user, so routes for a household refuse one.

MasterPin.name: X-Bonfire-Master-Pin
MasterPin.description: The main account's PIN, when it has one. Check it once with `POST /account/verify-pin` and keep it for the session. Without it the route returns 400 `pin_missing`; a wrong one returns `pin_wrong` and counts toward the rate limit. Where a route documents `masterPin` in its body, that works too.

XBonfireError.description: A code that never changes once released. Branch on this, not on the body. See the Errors section of the Developer API page. New codes can be added in any release; treat one you do not know by its status code.

Refused.description: Refused. The body says why, and `X-Bonfire-Error` says which.

schema.description: A message written for the user. Show it.

Unauthenticated.description: No token, or the token was rejected (`unauthenticated`). Sign in again. The only case that gets a 401.

schema.description: A message written for the user. Show it.

Forbidden.description: Signed in but not allowed: a profile on a main-account route, a non-administrator on an administrator route, or an API key on a route that needs a person. Keep the session.

schema.description: A message written for the user. Show it.

NotFound.description: Unknown profile, image, library or main account.

schema.description: A message written for the user. Show it.

RateLimited.description: Rate limited (`rate_limited`). Most limits also send `Retry-After` in seconds.

schema.description: A message written for the user. Show it.

apiVersion.description: Goes up only when a released route changes in a way that breaks callers.

disabled.description: An administrator has switched Bonfire off.

email.description: Outgoing mail is set up and tested.

pinResetByEmail.description: Email is available and the administrator's switch is on.

features.description: Server-wide settings only, never anything about a household. Read this rather than comparing version numbers.

avatarInitial.description: One letter for an avatar with no image.

transparentAvatar.description: Do not paint `avatarColor` behind the image.

theme.description: The account owner only. The profile's own theme, or null if it follows the server default.

requiresPin.description: Ask for a PIN before switching now. False on the home network when the bypass is on, and for a main account whose owner turned off `askPinToOpen`.

hasPin.description: A PIN is set. Use this, not `requiresPin`, to show PIN state in a form.

askPinToOpen.description: The main account, to its owner only. Off, the account opens without its PIN; the PIN still guards changes.

isAdministrator.description: Main accounts only, and only the caller's own household. For warnings, not for access checks.

lockoutMinutes.description: Minutes of inactivity before the profile locks. 0 is never.

maxSubProfiles.description: Main accounts only, and only the caller's own household.

enabledFolders.description: Profiles only. The libraries it was given.

allLibraries.description: Profiles only. It was given every library, including ones added later.

bypassPinOnLocalNetwork.description: Skip the PIN on the home network.

seenOnLocalNetwork.description: The caller's own household has made a request from the server's network. Set once, never cleared.

allowedDeviceIds.description: Devices it may be opened on. Empty means any.

isBonfire.description: Belongs to another household in the caller's Bonfire, or is an added account.

isLinked.description: Another main account added to the caller's switcher.

masterUserId.description: The main account it belongs to.

viewing.description: Profiles in the caller's household with viewing hours on: the `GET /limits/{profileId}` shape without `rules`.

profileCount.description: Profiles in the household, not counting the main account.

items.description: A theme file, schema 1. See docs/themes.md.

message.description: Plain text. Never render it as HTML.

pending.description: Show it now. False for a profile, when it is off, or once seen.

generation.description: Changes when the administrator shows it again.

steps.description: In order. Empty when not pending.

pin.description: 4 to 8 digits. Omit for no PIN. On update, `""` clears it.

theme.description: A theme id. Omit or `""` to follow the server default. Ignored on create while the server does not let profiles choose.

maxParentalRating.description: A rating score, such as `"6"`, `"10"`, `"14"` or `"17"`. Never above the main account's. `""` or omitted is no limit of its own.

enabledFolders.description: The libraries it may see. `[]` is none.

allLibraries.description: `true` for every library the main account has. Not with `enabledFolders`.

items.description: If set, it sees only items with one of these tags.

masterPin.description: Needed when the main account has a PIN. The `X-Bonfire-Master-Pin` header works too.

askPinToOpen.description: On `/update` for the main account only. See `POST /account`.

avatarLibraryId.description: An image from the avatar library. Wins over `profileImage`.

ProfileRequest.description: On `/update`, every field left out or `null` stays as it is.

isStarter.description: A built-in avatar. Its id starts with `starter-`.

FormOptions.description: An administrator's API key is answered with `timeZones` only; the other three parts are null.

detail.description: English. Show your own text by `code`.

isVersionStale.description: Always false. Kept so existing clients keep working.

serviceAccount.description: The account Jellyfin runs as, for writing a permissions command.

restartRequired.description: This version was installed after Jellyfin started. Do not show it as a failure.

newerVersionInstalled.description: An update is waiting for a restart. Null means unknown, not "no".

middlewareActive.description: It has served the web page at least once. This is the "working" signal.
